thread:
incident-bot: INCIDENT — meter-writeback-lag detected for billing-emit cluster. Overage flags toggled for a subset of accounts. Pager routed to oncall.
jamal: oncall here, acknowledging. seeing the pager. digging in.
maria: i'm seeing customer accounts flickering with overage flags in the billing UI — A-1001, B-2034, C-778. can confirm not actual token surge from logs yet.
alex: quick checks: kafka consumer group `billing-writes` has lag ~220k msgs for partition set 3-7. running:
```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --bootstrap-server kafka:9092 --group billing-writes --describe
CURRENT-OFFSET  LAG  TOPIC
... 220000 ... billing-writes
```
jamal: thanks. that matches the emitter backlog metric. any recent deploys to the emitter or writeback service?
emily: no deploys in last 6 hours from release bot. customer-impact reported via CS (DMs piling in).
sre-bot: runbook link: https://internal/runbooks/metering/writeback-lag
sre-bot: recommended mitigation step 1) pause overage-alerts 2) scale billing-writes consumers 3) schedule backfill job
maria: pausing overage notifications now (config flag `billing.alerts.enabled=false`) — will post once done.
jamal: scaling consumers: bumped consumer replicas from 4 -> 12 on billing-writepool, autoscaler taking effect. command:
```
kubectl -n infra scale deployment billing-write-consumer --replicas=12
```
alex: also increasing `consumer.fetch.min.bytes` to reduce chattiness; watching lag metric.
maria: paused alerts applied. sending note to status page: "Intermittent billing notification anomalies while we mitigate a writeback lag. Some customers may see temporary overage flags."
emily: CS notified and triaging high-priority customers. please DM if any churn risk accounts.
jamal: starting backfill once lag < 10k. estimate 35-50m to clear given current scale. will run backfill job with dry-run first for one org.
alex: started dry-run backfill for A-1001, looks clean. enqueueing full backfill now.
sre-bot: monitoring: lag trending down from 220k -> 48k in 12m after scale-up.
maria: after backfill completes we'll re-enable alerts and reconcile charges if needed. logging a customer-impact ticket to Billing ops.
jamal: handoff to night oncall in 40m. current owner: jamal -> follow-up owner: taylor (night oncall). leaving notes in incident board.
emily: posting update to status page and to impacted customers via CS templates. ETA to fully clear: ~45m.
alex: root cause likely slowed writeback consumer throughput combined with transient emitter spike. will open an RCA ticket once stable.
maria: confirmed no irreversible billing applied yet; charges gated until backfill complete.
jamal: thanks everyone — monitoring loop continues, will post final when cleared. :white_check_mark:
